auth.invalid: That email and password did not match.
auth.pendingTitle: Your account is waiting for approval
auth.pendingBody: An admin needs to activate your account and set your role before you can use the CRM.
auth.noAccess: You do not have access to this page.

sale.title: New sale
sale.scanPrompt: Scan a barcode or type a SKU
sale.emptyBasket: Nothing in the basket yet. Scan an item to begin.
sale.insufficient: Not enough stock for {{sku}}. Someone may have just sold the last one.
sale.customerPhoneHint: Optional, but it is what links a customer to their past orders
sale.queuedForPacking: Added to the packing queue, waiting for its confirmation call.

stock.title: Stock
stock.adjustHelp: Use a negative number to take stock out. The change is recorded against your name and cannot be edited afterwards.
stock.empty: No products yet. Import them from Shopify first.

sync.title: Sync issues
sync.empty: The CRM and Shopify agree on everything.
sync.trustCrmHelp: Leaves stock alone and pushes our number to Shopify again.
sync.trustShopifyHelp: Records an adjustment bringing the CRM in line with Shopify.
sync.noSkuDetail: {{count}} variants in Shopify have no SKU, so the CRM cannot track them. Add the SKUs in Shopify - this closes on its own once they arrive.
sync.numbersFrom: Shopify's numbers are from the check at {{when}}. If stock was changed in Shopify after that, press “Check with Shopify now” first.

queue.title: Packing queue
queue.outcomeHelp: Cancelling here saves a courier run out and another one back.
queue.holdUntilHelp: It drops out of this queue until that date.
queue.driverHelp: They hold the cash until they hand it in. The order stays here, under their name, until then.
queue.refusedHint: Customer refused? Check it back in on Returns with the order number.
queue.shipmentNumberNeeded: Enter or scan the courier's shipment number first.
queue.shipmentNumberTaken: That shipment number is already on another parcel. Check the label.

returns.title: Returns
returns.scanPrompt: Scan the code on the parcel, or type an order number
returns.emptyInbound: Nothing is on its way back.
returns.notFound: No parcel or order with that code.
returns.notReturnable: There is nothing to check in for {{orderNumber}} right now.
returns.needsFailureHelp: Nobody recorded this failure yet. Pick a reason and it gets recorded and checked in together.
returns.needsPostDeliveryHelp: This was never shipped, or was delivered outside the courier - it never had a tracking code. Pick a reason and it gets recorded and checked in together.
returns.resellableHelp: An opened parcel that just needs repackaging counts as back in stock.
returns.shortWarning: This parcel is {{count}} short. It will stay open for someone to chase.
returns.listEmpty: Nothing here matches. Press Enter to look it up anyway.

settlements.title: Courier settlements
settlements.referenceHelp: So a line on your bank statement can be traced back here next year.
settlements.netReceivedHelp: What actually landed in the account, from their notification.
settlements.trackingHelp: Scan it or type it. The amount fills itself in from the order.
settlements.noLines: Nothing entered yet. Work down their statement, one line at a time.
settlements.outOfBalance: This does not balance. Find the missing {{amount}} before signing it off.
settlements.awaitingEmpty: Everything the courier has finished with has been settled.
settlements.awaitingHelp: Parcels the courier has finished with that have not appeared on any statement. Older than their usual cycle means money to chase.
settlements.noProducts: No delivered orders on this statement yet.
settlements.copyManually: Selected — copy it with your keyboard or a long press.
settlements.lineNoteHint: Optional — e.g. they collected a different amount
settlements.pickOpen: Pick from {{count}} parcels not yet settled
settlements.adjustmentIncomplete: Give it a description and an amount that is not zero.

orders.title: Orders
orders.addItem: Add an item by SKU or name
orders.badPhone: That phone number is not valid.
orders.lockedPaid: This order has been paid for, so its money and contents cannot change. Only the note and the customer details can be corrected.
orders.reopenHelp: Only for a payment recorded by mistake. The order goes back to unpaid with the method you choose, and your reason is saved in its history under your name.
orders.reopenMethod: What the payment method should have been
orders.reopenOnStatement: This order is on a courier statement, so its money was counted against that statement and cannot be reopened.
orders.lockedReturned: This order was returned, so its money and contents are closed. Only the note and the customer details can be corrected.

reports.title: Reports and log
reports.truncated: Showing the most recent {{count}} entries. Narrow the dates to see the rest.
reports.refusalCostHelp: A refused parcel pays a full shipping fee and comes back with nothing to show for it. This is money spent on nothing.
reports.noRefusals: No refused parcels in this period.
reports.reliabilityHelp: Who refuses delivery. Useful for deciding who should be asked to pay up front.
reports.cohortsHelp: Measured against the week a parcel was handed over, not the week it came back. A cohort younger than 14 days is still moving and will get worse before it settles.
reports.noUnsettled: Nothing delivered is waiting on its money.

custody.overdueHelp: Delivery takes three to five days and a refusal comes back within two or three. Anything past that needs a phone call.
custody.allTitle: Everything with the courier right now
custody.shortHelp: A counted shortfall recorded at check-in — not a suspicion, a confirmed loss.

staff.title: Staff
staff.addHint: New logins are created in the Supabase dashboard (Authentication → Users). They show up here automatically, inactive, ready to activate.
staff.name: Name
staff.activateAndSetRole: Activate this account and give it a role.
